title: Father Knows Best
paragraphs: A family situation comedy about Jim and Margaret Anderson and their children, using everyday household problems and generational misunderstandings for warm comedy.
Family situation comedy centered on Jim and Margaret Anderson and children Betty, Bud and Kathy.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: Audition (December 20, 1948 to December 20, 1948), Audition (December 20, 1948 to December 20, 1948), NBC sponsored weekly run (August 25, 1949 to May 21, 1953) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], and NBC early family cast (August 25, 1949 to July 5, 1951) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Bill Forman (announcer, narrator, and performer), [[person|robert-young|Robert Young]] (performer), Ed James (creator, writer, and performer), Rhoda Williams (performer), Ted Donaldson (performer), Norma Jean Nilsson (performer), and Jean VanderPyl (performer).
Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]].

The stories often return to parenting and household authority, family relationships, home maintenance and domestic projects, household money and allowance, holidays and family celebrations, and teen dating and courtship.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Radio-to-television transition, Postwar suburban family sitcom, Robert Young good-driver campaign, and Consumer household culture.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|the-railroad-hour|The Railroad Hour]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], and [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]].
